posts.subject: Oxygen abusing
posts.bodyHtml:
Today I was playing on the knife server obviously killing everyone because I am MLG but Oxygen comes on and whilst he was on I say in chat "Why do all these fags run so much" so he warns me. I then do it again which I know is bad but I say "fag" in chat. I get kicked for disrespect and ever since then he decides that I am on his bad list so he will be watching and picking out anything I do which may be wrong, no one else.


Later on, several times in chat I say who is 2vs1'ing if they do. After several times he does nothing then later on I write "Stop 2vs1'ing" and he says "I need names... I can't do anything without names". Therefore I reply about how I said it several times in chat and he ignores that and continues playing. Therefore I done !calladmin and reported him for not doing his job because he wasn't. Approximately 2 minutes later he kicks me saying that I'm doing "Fase calladmin" I guess he meant "False" but just can't spell.


I then go afk for about 30 mins then come back and I was 1v1ing someone and he was just running then suddenly turned around which I completely unexpected. In return I type in chat "Why does everyone run so much" "Gayyy" Then he kicks me again for "Disrespect".
I then came back on the server and done !calladmin and reported him for Abusing powers because he basically was... He just kicked me. I didn't even have to wait long before that and I was then banned. I come here and look and the reason was "/noreason".


Please sort this guy out and make him default. He abuses too much. [dumm**] [right*]
Also... I don't mean to be rude but how does this guy have admin with the amount of bans and stuff he has done before and in the past. Just wondering because I see ban apologies from him, bans on the banlist and complaints. Sort it out lads.

Hello RoyalFapp,


I have been ashamed of your behaviour that you proofed to me on the knife server where I gave you multiple warning with your language and disrespecting other players which is strongly against the rules, also the ban reason on source bans was edited and there is a strong reason why I have banned you basically I have warned multiple times then I decided to kick you as you received too many warning but you carried on with such a behaviour.
<-- Saying "You can't say shit" towards me
<-- Calling someone a "faggot"
<-- Telling me to "stfu"
<-- At that moment I was afk because I was searching for part time works on internet as I'm legally able to work in the UK and my csgo was tabbed out so I was unable to see what is happening at the server.
<-- Last report you did when I was on the server saying I power abuse which I strongly disagree as you received multiple warnings and 2 kicks before you got banned which did not help you chill down.

Wait a second..
So you're complaining about the fact that you got kicked for insulting other players?
Looks like @'OxygeN' just did his job.


close please
Mate, you're a bad admin... Face it
